import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create the catplot for survival rate by passenger class and sex
g = sns.catplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    col='sex',
    kind='bar',
    errorbar='ci', # Show confidence intervals
    palette='viridis',
    height=5,
    aspect=1.2
)

# Set titles and labels
g.set_axis_labels("Passenger Class", "Survival Rate")
g.set_titles("Survival Rate for {col_name}")
g.fig.suptitle("Titanic Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex", y=1.03, fontsize=16) # Adjust y to prevent overlap

# Ensure class labels are clear
g.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
